It is a ceiling on gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities), not a promised rent: the PHA also caps rent at local comparable unassisted rents (rent reasonableness) and subtracts tenant-paid utilities. checklist.why: 4 bedroom(s) (estimated from LiDAR footprint & stories). PHAs size vouchers at about 2 persons per bedroom; a bedroom must be a sleeping room with a window (HQS) and usually an openable egress window and a door. Extra bedrooms beyond the voucher size earn no extra subsidy. footprint 315 m2 x 1 stories (LiDAR height estimate) x 0.8 = ~252 m2 living area; conservative, capped at 4.

Gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities) must be at or below the PHA payment standard, about $1,898-$2,320/month here for 4BR, and no higher than comparable unassisted rents. Published PHA standard: $2,081 (Huntsville Housing Authority (HHA, hsvha.org), PHA schedule, ZIP 35802). We do not estimate a rent for this house. year built unknown; if before 1978 and a child under 6 will live there the Lead-Safe Housing Rule applies

a permanently installed, working heat source (no unvented space heaters) is required in HUD-designated climate zones; also hot and cold running water. Not visible in our data.
safe path from the unit door to the street; living room and each sleeping room need a window (HQS), and most PHAs want bedroom windows that open for escape.

no warning signs in the exterior data we have (roof surface spread 8.8 cm), but no city code-case data for this house; interior condition unknown
